at_sea:
AKIEN STATED THE DESIGN AND IT RESHAPES WHAT JUST SHIPPED. Verbatim at CairnCommons/ideas/2026-08-18-intention-an-infernce-call-is-made-a.json: an inference call creates a TASK TICKET carrying the whole call — who asked (CALL CHAIN OR MESSAGE ENVELOPE, a fork he named in the same breath and did not settle), the request, the answer, model specified and model selected, provider specified and provider selected, escalations along the way and their back-and-forth, exceptions thrown, and the graph-tree nodes that came back if it went by the trees first. On failure a TROUBLE is ALSO raised POINTING AT the log entry; a recurrence is added to the existing trouble. When nothing can resolve the request, an INTELLIGIBLE MESSAGE explaining the failure goes back to the caller.

The voyage a-refused-ask-leaves-a-row is PROVED and pushed (cairn cade154), and it is a SLIVER of that in the wrong shape: one word, verdict='refused', in a cache column. It works — first refused row 2026-08-18T01:28:54, probe green (post_era_rows 22, refused 1, offending 0, enough True) — and it answers 'how often does this door fail' while answering none of the rest.

THE DESIGN WAS ALREADY IN THE CHARTER AND I READ IT AS A METAPHOR: inference_domain/intention+why.json says 'an inference request is a TICKET (a workflow node)'. I had queued work to RENAME those 5 sites AWAY from the word. That rename must not happen — it would have destroyed the one place the design was written.

CORRECTIONS LANDED THIS SESSION (commons 4f9b933, cairn cade154). Three records carried a false ground-loop caveat: it claimed pid 973171 is a long-running inference caller on pre-build code, so a standing zero refused was ambiguous and only Akien's restart could disambiguate it. FALSE — the ground loop makes NO inference calls (one prose grep hit, no code path; no armed probe calls resolve()). The traffic is /api/embed to nomic-embed-text, domain 'research', 205 of the last 400 — the graph-tree embedding in cairn/tools/tree/tree.py fired by chart counsel/learn and the librarian, short-lived processes loading fresh code. NO RESTART IS OWED BY ANYONE. Fixed in the probe docstring and the ticket distinctions (correction left standing, false version not deleted). A second false sentence fixed in the charter: a CHECK on the verdict column was called unreachable through db_domain's one door; create_owned_table passes column types through sql.SQL() raw, so a CHECK at CREATION always was reachable — only a table that ALREADY STANDS has no door. Recompile gate poked.

STILL FALSE ON DISK, blocked on the missing amend lane: inference_domain/history.json's PROVED note carries both wrong sentences, and slate 2026-08-18 + commit dc10cfa still say num_ctx is not the discriminator (it is — cold load AND large num_ctx, a conjunction).
next_direction:
RESHAPE BEFORE BUILDING ANYTHING. Akien agreed to a restart of the session at this boundary, so the next mind starts here.

(1) Reshape ticket the-inference-ticket-comes-back-whole (CairnCommons/tickets/, still at TICKETME, uncast). It covers two of his fields — retrievability of the row, and the host's RAW RESPONSE BODY — and none of: who asked, model/provider SPECIFIED vs SELECTED, escalations and their back-and-forth, graph-tree nodes returned, the trouble pointer, the intelligible failure message. Measured delta against the live table: inference_calls has 8 columns (answer, canonical, cost, created, falsifier, horizon, provenance, verdict); provenance already carries model SELECTED and provider SELECTED; everything else on his list is absent.

(2) ASK HIM THE FORK HE LEFT OPEN — call chain or message envelope. He said both in one breath and settled neither. It decides whether 'who asked' is reconstructed from the stack or rides with the request, and it is the difference between a crawler and a field.

(3) The trouble half needs no new dedup machinery: cairn/devices/trouble already does 'first raise writes a ticket and notifies; every recurrence while live increments a count'. What does not exist is ANY link at all — measured 2026-08-18, zero mentions of trouble anywhere under cairn/devices/inference_domain/.

DO NOT BUILD, both now carry standing_note fields saying so: the-verdict-vocabulary-is-held-by-postgres and yield-report-names-its-refusals. Both act on the current row shape, which this reshapes. The defect yield-report names is real either way — yield_report's `calls` is len(rows) and no longer equals hits + misses (2564 vs 2563), on a surface librarian and intention_extractor print to a human. a-standing-table-gains-its-constraint-through-the-one-door survives independently: db_domain has no ALTER anywhere, and that is true whatever the row shape becomes.
open_threads: THE FORK AKIEN LEFT OPEN: 'call chain or message envelope!' — who-asked reconstructed from the stack, or carried with the request. His words, unsettled, and it shapes the whole record.

AMEND LANE STILL ABSENT — the standing trouble a-clear-carries-a-false-statement-and-the-lane-has-no-door-to-correct-it now blocks THREE published falsehoods, not one: the ground-loop caveat and the CHECK claim in inference_domain/history.json's PROVED note, and the num_ctx sentence in slate 2026-08-18 and commit dc10cfa. Build TroubleDevice.amend and arm cairn/devices/trouble/probes/an_amendment_reaches_a_reader.py.
DO NOT rename the 5 inference-request-as-TICKET sites. That queued work is backwards — the word is the design, stated in the charter and confirmed by Akien 2026-08-18.

MY FAILURE SHAPE, TWICE IN THIS SESSION AND BOTH PUBLISHED: two things I knew, joined by a causal sentence, never checked against the store that would kill it. num_ctx/timeout, then the ground loop. One Counter over provenance['path'] killed the second. Kin memory: verified-on-disk-before-done, face 8.
